method: Targeted PE string, RIP-relative, call and absolute xrefs over the file on disk; every hop confirmed by bounded objdump disassembly of its own range. Scratch tooling was temporary and is not retained.
installs: none; x86_64-w64-mingw32-objdump, strings and Python 3.14.8 stdlib already present
counter_source: Game/Ui/Widgets/Inventory/InvButtonBar.cpp, RVA 0x6A2930: inventory slot 0x1F0 for the total, slot 0x1E8 for the used count, then text 0xBCFA with both numbers
capacity_method: inventory vtable 0x21621A8 slot 0x1F0 -> RVA 0x11EE520: loops bag index below slot 0x148 and adds slot 0x140
bag_slot_count: DWORD at inventory+0x440 (slot 0x148 -> RVA 0x11EE300); the setter at RVA 0x1291130 asserts it is at most 16
bag_list: 16 item pointers at inventory+0x380 (slot 0x138 -> RVA 0x12908E0), ChCliItemStorageBags.cpp
bag_size: slot 0x140 -> RVA 0x1290930: item slot 8 (RVA 0x13C3E10, item+0x40) gives the definition; definition+0x2C must be 3; definition+0x30 is the bag payload; payload+0x28 is the size
bag_item_class: ItCliBag.cpp constructor at RVA 0x13C8CF0 installs vtable 0x225D070, whose slot 8 is the shared definition getter
array_layout: position = bag index * 32 + slot in bag (RVA 0x1290860 splits with shr 5; RVA 0x1290AC0 accepts a slot only when bag index < slot count and slot in bag < bag size). The layout alone does not give the sizes.
used_count: slot 0x1E8 -> RVA 0x11EE4E0: non-null entries of the array at inventory+0xC8 with count inventory+0xD4
artifact_format: Hashes of guarded ranges only in profile.json; no bytes of the binary and no live data retained
